title: Salary.
bodyText: The salary of the state fire marshal and deputy state fire marshal shall be equal to the salary of the director and deputy director of human resources development, respectively.
bodyHtml: [§132-41]  Salary.  The salary of the state fire marshal and deputy state fire marshal shall be equal to the salary of the director and deputy director of human resources development, respectively. [L 2025, c 302, pt of §3]
